editorial.use: Species names, titles, latin binomials, packaging. The voice of the brand.

sans.use: Body copy, UI, navigation. Everything read as prose.

mono.stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.use: Field metadata: codes, lots, coordinates, telemetry. Always uppercase, tracking >= 0.15em.

display-01.use: Cover titles, packaging front, poster. One per surface.

heading-03.use: Sub-headings inside prose and SOP steps.

latin.use: Latin binomial. 'Ganoderma lucidum'. Always italic, always sentence case.

body.use: Prose floor. Never below 16px on screen or print.

small.use: Captions, secondary UI, dense card copy.

label.use: Field keys, table headers, taxon codes, lot lines.

micro.use: Plate refs, folio marks, legal fine print. Never operative content.

minimums.prose: 16px — body copy never goes lower, screen or print
minimums.operative: 13px — below this, metadata only; no information a person must act on
minimums.monoTracking: 0.15em — mono is always uppercase and always tracked
